svg.title: Review independent scientific checks added through the Codex editor GUI
svg.desc: 1: Check the unequal-error expectation of 3.6 against the independent hand calculation. 2: Review the matching two-dimensional inputs and their ValueError expectation. 3: Read the reported baseline: 11 failed and 1 passed before repairing the function.
